meta.note: Curated top-100 seed. Run npm run data:refresh or use Refresh data to expand and enrich the catalog.

commanders.name: Y'shtola, Night's Blessed
commanders.tagline: Quiet healer, relentless bookkeeper
commanders.blurb: Every meaningful spell you cast pings the whole table and heals you, and every big life swing refills your hand. Gentle on the surface, mathematically brutal underneath.
commanders.plan: Cast midsize noncreature spells, drain the table two at a time, draw off the carnage.
commanders.youAre: Caring but calculating. You take care of people and also keep a very accurate ledger.

commanders.name: Edgar Markov
commanders.tagline: An aristocratic vampire family, arriving all at once
commanders.blurb: Every vampire you cast makes another vampire from the command zone, and attacking pumps them all. One of the most relentless starts in the format.
commanders.plan: Flood the board with vampires, pump the team, attack every single turn.
commanders.youAre: Stylish, proud, and dangerously committed to a theme. Half the joy is the aesthetic.
media: What We Do in the Shadows

commanders.name: The Ur-Dragon
commanders.tagline: Every dragon you've ever wanted, in one deck
commanders.blurb: Dragons cost less, attacking draws a fistful of cards, and you get to drop free permanents out of hand. Expensive, enormous, exactly as cool as it sounds.
commanders.plan: Ramp hard, cast dragons at a discount, attack with a flying apocalypse.
commanders.youAre: A big-dream player. If you're going to do a thing, do it at full scale.

commanders.name: Atraxa, Praetors' Voice
commanders.tagline: Everything good gets a little better each turn
commanders.blurb: Proliferate every end step: counters on creatures, loyalty on planeswalkers, poison on opponents. A quiet compounding nightmare with four keywords stapled on.
commanders.plan: Put counters on everything, proliferate them, snowball into inevitability.
commanders.youAre: Long-game, incremental, and deeply satisfied by a number that keeps going up.

commanders.name: Krenko, Mob Boss
commanders.tagline: One goblin, then a thousand goblins
commanders.blurb: The math is simple and horrifying: tap Krenko, double the goblins, swing. Nobody has ever needed a strategy guide for this.
commanders.plan: Make goblins exponentially, then throw all of them at someone's face.
commanders.youAre: Enthusiastic, loud, allergic to subtlety. The plan is the plan and the plan is great.

commanders.name: Vivi Ornitier
commanders.tagline: A small black mage with a frightening mana bill
commanders.blurb: Every noncreature spell grows Vivi and burns the table, and Vivi taps for mana equal to his own power. Start small, end the turn casting your whole hand.
commanders.plan: Chain cheap spells, grow Vivi, convert him into a mana engine and a win condition.
commanders.youAre: Shy, curious, and secretly the most dangerous person at the table once warmed up.

commanders.name: Sauron, the Dark Lord
commanders.tagline: The eye that punishes you for casting spells
commanders.blurb: Every time an opponent does anything, your army grows. Connect once and you get to throw away your hand for four fresh cards. Patient, oppressive, thematic.
commanders.plan: Amass an army off opponents' spells, tempt the Ring, refill and grind them down.
commanders.youAre: Strategically patient and faintly menacing. You like being the problem on the board.

commanders.name: Kaalia of the Vast
commanders.tagline: Cheat the biggest things in the game into combat
commanders.blurb: Attack and an Angel, Demon or Dragon slams onto the battlefield attacking, for free. Everyone at the table immediately agrees you must be dealt with.
commanders.plan: Protect Kaalia, attack once, drop a 7-drop into combat and repeat.
commanders.youAre: Impatient with the boring middle part. You want the good stuff on turn four.

commanders.name: Teval, the Balanced Scale
commanders.tagline: Your graveyard is a renewable resource
commanders.blurb: Attack, mill yourself, return a land, make a zombie — and every other card that leaves your graveyard makes another one. Self-destruction as an economy.
commanders.plan: Mill yourself on purpose, recur lands and creatures, build a zombie army from scraps.
commanders.youAre: A composter. Nothing is waste if you're patient enough to turn it over.

commanders.name: Fire Lord Azula
commanders.tagline: Perfectionist, prodigy, copies everything
commanders.blurb: Attack and every spell you cast gets copied, with extra red mana thrown in to fund it. Terrifying ceiling, zero chill, exactly on brand.
commanders.plan: Swing, then duplicate your best spells mid-combat for an unanswerable turn.
commanders.youAre: Brilliant, exacting, and competitive in a way your friends gently tease you about.

commanders.name: Giada, Font of Hope
commanders.tagline: A choir of angels, arriving on schedule
commanders.blurb: One clean idea executed beautifully: play angels, each one lands bigger than the last, fly over everything. Looks like a cathedral, hits like a truck.
commanders.plan: Flood the sky with angels that grow every time another one arrives.
commanders.youAre: Orderly, loyal and a little theatrical. You like a plan everyone sees coming and still can't stop.

commanders.name: Pantlaza, Sun-Favored
commanders.tagline: Every dinosaur you play finds another free card
commanders.blurb: Each dinosaur that lands digs into your deck and casts something for free. It's tribal beatdown with an actual card-advantage engine bolted on.
commanders.plan: Play big dinosaurs, discover into more dinosaurs, trample over everyone.
commanders.youAre: Earnest and enthusiastic. You like a plan that pays you for sticking to it.

commanders.name: Ms. Bumbleflower
commanders.tagline: Aggressively nice, quietly unstoppable
commanders.blurb: Every spell gives an opponent a card and grows one of yours. You become everyone's favourite player and then win because you drew eleven cards doing it.
commanders.plan: Give gifts, grow fliers, double-dip every turn for extra draws.
commanders.youAre: Genuinely kind at the table. Also, somehow, always in the lead.

commanders.name: Lathril, Blade of the Elves
commanders.tagline: Ten elves walk into a bar; everyone loses ten life
commanders.blurb: Build an elf army, connect once for more elves, then tap ten of them to drain the whole table. Tribal loyalty with a knife behind the back.
commanders.plan: Swarm with elves, then convert the army into massive simultaneous drain.
commanders.youAre: Community-minded with an edge. You like belonging to something, and winning with it.

commanders.name: Toph, the First Metalbender
commanders.tagline: Your artifacts are lands and your lands are monsters
commanders.blurb: A genuinely weird text box: the inanimate stuff you own becomes terrain, and the terrain gets up and attacks. Strange, resilient and extremely fun to pilot.
commanders.plan: Turn artifacts into lands, earthbend lands into creatures, attack with the floor.
commanders.youAre: Stubborn, inventive, and completely uninterested in the normal way of doing things.

commanders.name: The Wise Mothman
commanders.tagline: Irradiate everyone and see what grows
commanders.blurb: You hand out rad counters that slowly mill your opponents, and every mill trigger pumps your team. A creepy, friendly, very original engine.
commanders.plan: Spread rad counters, mill the table, convert milling into +1/+1 counters.
commanders.youAre: Drawn to the strange. You'd absolutely pull over for a roadside cryptid museum.

commanders.name: Jodah, the Unifier
commanders.tagline: A deck made entirely of main characters
commanders.blurb: Every legend you cast cascades into another legend, and they all pump each other. It's a crossover event with a mana base.
commanders.plan: Cast legendary creatures, chain free ones off the top, swing with a superteam.
commanders.youAre: A collector of favourites. Your playlist, bookshelf and deck are all greatest hits.

commanders.name: Cloud, Ex-SOLDIER
commanders.tagline: One hero, one absurdly large sword
commanders.blurb: Equipment attaches itself, attacking draws cards for every equipped creature, and if Cloud gets big enough you get paid in treasure too.
commanders.plan: Suit up a single hero, attack, draw cards, repeat until someone is dead.
commanders.youAre: A min-maxer with a favourite character. You build one thing and you build it perfectly.

commanders.name: Hearthhull, the Worldseed
commanders.tagline: A spaceship that eats the planet for fuel
commanders.blurb: Sacrifice lands to draw cards and play more lands, and once it's fully crewed it's a flying 6/7 that pays you for the destruction.
commanders.plan: Sacrifice and replay lands for cards, then launch a huge flying engine.
commanders.youAre: A tinkerer with no sentimentality. Everything is raw material for the next thing.

commanders.name: Nekusar, the Mindrazer
commanders.tagline: Here, everyone draw cards. (That's the trap.)
commanders.blurb: You hand out cards and charge admission in life. Wheels, discard and punishment turn generosity into a weapon.
commanders.plan: Force everyone to draw while every draw hurts them, then wheel until they're gone.
commanders.youAre: Mischievous and a little villainous. You enjoy a gift with strings attached.

commanders.name: Kefka, Court Mage
commanders.tagline: The clown who actually wins
commanders.blurb: Everyone discards, you draw for the variety, and eventually he flips into a flying nightmare that makes everyone sacrifice things. Pure gleeful malice.
commanders.plan: Strip hands, profit off the discards, transform and end the world.
commanders.youAre: The friend who laughs during the disaster. Chaos, but with a plan underneath.

commanders.name: Kenrith, the Returned King
commanders.tagline: A king who grants favors — for a price
commanders.blurb: Kenrith can give any player cards, life, trample or a reanimated creature. Every ability is a negotiation and you're holding the bank.
commanders.plan: Ramp into all five colors and trade favors until the table owes you the game.
commanders.youAre: A natural diplomat. Your real deck is the other three players.

commanders.name: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER
commanders.tagline: Every death is a small deposit
commanders.blurb: Feed him creatures for cards, drain a life each time anything dies, and on the fourth death in a turn he becomes a one-winged flying disaster.
commanders.plan: Sacrifice relentlessly, drain the table, flip into a finisher.
commanders.youAre: Cool, composed, and running a plan you decided on a long time ago.

commanders.name: Yuriko, the Tiger's Shadow
commanders.tagline: The knife you never saw
commanders.blurb: Cheap unblockable creatures bounce in and out while Yuriko flips cards off the top and drains everyone. Quiet, cheap, lethal.
commanders.plan: Sneak ninjas through, flip expensive cards off the top, drain the whole table at once.
commanders.youAre: Patient and precise. You'd rather be underestimated for nine turns and inevitable on the tenth.

commanders.name: Isshin, Two Heavens as One
commanders.tagline: If it triggers on attack, it triggers twice
commanders.blurb: A deceptively simple text box that doubles everything good about attacking. Combat becomes a snowball nobody can afford to let roll.
commanders.plan: Double every attack trigger and convert combat into overwhelming advantage.
commanders.youAre: Decisive and forward-leaning. You believe pressure solves most problems.

commanders.name: Baylen, the Haymaker
commanders.tagline: A hundred tiny friends, each one a resource
commanders.blurb: Tokens aren't just bodies — tap them for mana, tap them for cards, tap them to make Baylen enormous. A token deck that never runs out of things to do.
commanders.plan: Make many small tokens, convert them into mana, cards and a lethal swing.
commanders.youAre: A small-wins optimizer. You get genuine joy out of an efficient little system.

commanders.name: Valgavoth, Harrower of Souls
commanders.tagline: Every scratch anyone takes feeds the demon
commanders.blurb: The first time each opponent loses life on their own turn, you grow and draw. Build a board that bleeds people passively and the cards never stop.
commanders.plan: Make opponents lose life constantly, draw a card every time, attack with a huge flier.
commanders.youAre: Patient and a bit sinister. You profit from other people's small mistakes.

commanders.name: Miirym, Sentinel Wyrm
commanders.tagline: Every dragon arrives with a twin
commanders.blurb: Each nontoken dragon you play makes a copy of itself. The board goes from manageable to apocalyptic in roughly one turn cycle.
commanders.plan: Ramp into dragons, double each one on arrival, attack with the sky.
commanders.youAre: A maximalist. 'Why one?' is a question you've genuinely never asked.

commanders.name: Chatterfang, Squirrel General
commanders.tagline: All of your tokens come with squirrels
commanders.blurb: Any token you'd make, you make squirrels too — and then you can eat the squirrels to kill things. Adorable, extremely degenerate.
commanders.plan: Double every token into squirrels, then sacrifice them for profit and removal.
commanders.youAre: Cute exterior, ruthless interior. Nobody expects the squirrels.

commanders.name: Ulalek, Fused Atrocity
commanders.tagline: Copy every spell and every ability. All of them.
commanders.blurb: Cast an Eldrazi, pay two, and everything you control happens twice. It's the most unreasonable text box in the top 100 and it knows it.
commanders.plan: Ramp into Eldrazi, then duplicate your entire turn in one trigger.
commanders.youAre: You want the biggest possible turn. Half-measures are offensive to you.

commanders.name: Hashaton, Scarab's Fist
commanders.tagline: Discard a monster, get a 4/4 copy of it
commanders.blurb: Throwing away your best creature is now the cheapest way to cast it. A reanimator deck that never actually has to reanimate anything.
commanders.plan: Loot aggressively, discard huge creatures, make zombie copies of them for cheap.
commanders.youAre: An efficiency obsessive. You found the shortcut and the shortcut is better.

commanders.name: Frodo, Adventurous Hobbit
commanders.tagline: A small, determined person carrying something awful
commanders.blurb: Gain life, become the Ring-bearer, draw cards, and let Sam quietly make treasure in the background. Underdog energy, genuinely strong engine.
commanders.plan: Gain life every turn, tempt the Ring, grind out cards and sneak damage through.
commanders.youAre: Humble and stubborn. You finish things other people would have quit.

commanders.name: Ashling, the Limitless
commanders.tagline: Elementals that die, come back as copies, and keep going
commanders.blurb: Everything gains evoke, so you can cast your whole hand cheaply — and every sacrifice hands you a hasty copy instead. Wonderfully chaotic value.
commanders.plan: Evoke elementals for cheap, convert their deaths into free hasty copies.
commanders.youAre: Improvisational. You'd rather make five things happen than one perfect thing.

commanders.name: Esika, God of the Tree
commanders.tagline: Free legends off the top, every single upkeep
commanders.blurb: The back half, The Prismatic Bridge, puts a free creature or planeswalker into play each turn. The front half turns your legends into mana. Both are great.
commanders.plan: Cast the Bridge, cheat a legend into play every upkeep, build an unfair board.
commanders.youAre: You like inevitability. Give you a few turns and the game is simply decided.

commanders.name: Bello, Bard of the Brambles
commanders.tagline: Your furniture gets up and fights
commanders.blurb: Every big artifact and enchantment you own becomes an indestructible hasty 4/4 that draws cards when it connects. Your noncreature spells are the beatdown.
commanders.plan: Play chunky artifacts and enchantments, animate them, swing with the scenery.
commanders.youAre: A lateral thinker. You like solving the problem with a tool nobody considered a weapon.

commanders.name: Muldrotha, the Gravetide
commanders.tagline: Your graveyard is a second hand
commanders.blurb: Each turn you may replay a permanent of each type from the graveyard. Nothing you lose is ever actually gone, which makes you impossible to grind out.
commanders.plan: Self-mill, then replay permanents from the yard every turn until you simply have more.
commanders.youAre: Persistent and a little bit of a hoarder. Losing things doesn't scare you.

commanders.name: Hakbal of the Surging Soul
commanders.tagline: A school of merfolk, exploring every turn
commanders.blurb: Each combat, every merfolk you control explores — free lands, free counters, free selection. Cheap, consistent and extremely satisfying.
commanders.plan: Build a merfolk board, explore every turn, ride the accumulated counters in.
commanders.youAre: Curious and methodical. You open every chest and read every sign.

commanders.name: Rin and Seri, Inseparable
commanders.tagline: Literally just dogs and cats
commanders.blurb: Cast a dog, get a cat. Cast a cat, get a dog. Then point the whole menagerie at someone's face. The sweetest deck that still kills people.
commanders.plan: Alternate dogs and cats for free tokens, then burn the table with the whole pack.
commanders.youAre: Wholesome and sociable. You're here for the vibes and also to win, politely.

commanders.name: Glarb, Calamity's Augur
commanders.tagline: A frog who already knows how this ends
commanders.blurb: See the top card always, play lands and expensive spells straight off your library, and surveil to fix what's coming. Card advantage without drawing cards.
commanders.plan: Set up the top of your deck, cast everything from the library, never run out.
commanders.youAre: A planner. You read the ending first and you're not sorry about it.

commanders.name: Animar, Soul of Elements
commanders.tagline: Creatures get cheaper until they're free
commanders.blurb: Every creature you cast shrinks the next one. Eventually you're casting your whole deck and the table is politely asking you to stop.
commanders.plan: Chain creatures at escalating discounts until you take an unreasonable turn.
commanders.youAre: A combo-curious optimizer who loves a turn that doesn't end.

commanders.name: Maralen, Fae Ascendant
commanders.tagline: Elves and faeries, casting other people's spells
commanders.blurb: Each elf or faerie exiles cards off an opponent's library, and you get to cast them for free. The tribe is your army and their decks are your hand.
commanders.plan: Build a wide elf-faerie board and play the table's cards instead of your own.
commanders.youAre: Sly and charming. Borrowing isn't stealing if you give it back as damage.

commanders.name: Arcades, the Strategist
commanders.tagline: Your walls attack. With their butts.
commanders.blurb: Defenders deal damage with their toughness and can attack, and each one draws you a card. The most comfortable fortress in Magic.
commanders.plan: Build an impenetrable wall of defenders, draw a card each time, then attack with the wall.
commanders.youAre: Defensive by nature and secretly very patient. Let them come to you.

commanders.name: Aragorn, the Uniter
commanders.tagline: Every spell you cast does a second, better thing
commanders.blurb: White makes soldiers, blue scrys, red burns, green pumps. Build a four-color pile of good cards and every single one over-performs.
commanders.plan: Cast spells of every color and bank the bonus triggers into an unstoppable board.
commanders.youAre: A natural leader who's good at a lot of things and modest about all of them.

commanders.name: Kuja, Genome Sorcerer
commanders.tagline: A vain sorcerer with a staff of wizards
commanders.blurb: Make a wizard every end step; each one pings the table whenever you cast a noncreature spell. Four wizards later, Kuja flips and the burn goes exponential.
commanders.plan: Build a wizard chorus, cast cheap spells, machine-gun the whole table.
commanders.youAre: Dramatic and a bit of a show-off. Style points matter to you. They should.

commanders.name: Mr. House, President and CEO
commanders.tagline: The house always wins (statistically)
commanders.blurb: Roll dice, make robots and treasure, spend the treasure to roll more dice. Gambling as an engine, with surprisingly consistent payouts.
commanders.plan: Generate treasure, roll huge dice pools, flood the board with 3/3 robots.
commanders.youAre: A calculated risk-taker. You love a gamble where you've quietly stacked the odds.

commanders.name: Ygra, Eater of All
commanders.tagline: Every creature on the board is now snacks
commanders.blurb: Ygra turns all creatures — yours and theirs — into Food, which means everything can be eaten, and every meal makes Ygra bigger. Absurd and delightful.
commanders.plan: Turn the whole board into Food, sacrifice it all, grow into something enormous.
commanders.youAre: Gleefully greedy. You read a card and immediately look for the broken part.

commanders.name: Caesar, Legion's Emperor
commanders.tagline: The legion is expendable and that's the point
commanders.blurb: Attack, feed a soldier to the machine, and pick two rewards: more soldiers, cards, or damage. A war engine that runs on its own troops.
commanders.plan: Attack every turn, sacrifice tokens for value, snowball into a lethal army.
commanders.youAre: Ruthlessly goal-oriented. Acceptable losses is a phrase you've used sincerely.

commanders.name: Wilhelt, the Rotcleaver
commanders.tagline: The zombies keep coming back. That's the whole bit.
commanders.blurb: Every zombie that dies leaves another zombie behind, and you can eat a zombie each turn for a card. A beginner-friendly engine that's genuinely strong.
commanders.plan: Build a zombie horde that replaces itself, draw off the deaths, swarm in.
commanders.youAre: Steady and unglamorous. You win with attrition and you're fine with that.

commanders.name: Flubs, the Fool
commanders.tagline: Empty your hand on purpose. It's a strategy. Honest.
commanders.blurb: If your hand is empty when you play something, you draw. Otherwise you discard. It is an aggressively silly constraint that produces genuinely clever decks.
commanders.plan: Dump your hand fast, then draw a card off everything you play.
commanders.youAre: A puzzle person with a sense of humour. Constraints make you more creative.

commanders.name: The Necrobloom
commanders.tagline: A garden growing out of the graveyard
commanders.blurb: Every land makes a plant or a zombie, and the lands in your graveyard come back on their own. Lands-matter with a body count.
commanders.plan: Play lands relentlessly, make a token every time, dredge the lands back.
commanders.youAre: Patient and nurturing, with a slightly morbid streak. Compost is sacred to you.

commanders.name: Ureni of the Unwritten
commanders.tagline: A dragon that goes and gets more dragons
commanders.blurb: Enters and attacks digging eight cards deep for a free dragon every time. Huge, trampling, and reliably unfair.
commanders.plan: Ramp into Ureni, cheat extra dragons into play on every attack.
commanders.youAre: Direct about wanting the biggest creatures. No notes, no apologies.

commanders.name: Oloro, Ageless Ascetic
commanders.tagline: Gains life from the command zone. Hasn't even cast him yet.
commanders.blurb: Two life a turn whether he's on the battlefield or not, and every life gain converts into a card and a drain. The most relaxed control deck imaginable.
commanders.plan: Gain life passively, convert it into cards and drain, win from behind a wall.
commanders.youAre: Unhurried and unbothered. You trust that time is on your side.

commanders.name: Breya, Etherium Shaper
commanders.tagline: Artifacts in, win conditions out
commanders.blurb: A toolbox commander who turns a pile of metal into removal, drain, life or a sudden combo kill. Infinitely modular.
commanders.plan: Build an artifact toolbox and assemble whichever combo the table can't answer.
commanders.youAre: A tinkerer. You like options, modules and solving the board like a puzzle.

commanders.name: Meren of Clan Nel Toth
commanders.tagline: Death is a doorway you keep propping open
commanders.blurb: Creatures die, Meren brings them back, they die again on purpose. A warm, mossy engine of inevitability.
commanders.plan: Sacrifice creatures for value and reanimate them for free, forever.
commanders.youAre: Quietly relentless. You outlast people more than you out-muscle them.

commanders.name: Tidus, Yuna's Guardian
commanders.tagline: Move the counters around until someone's enormous
commanders.blurb: Shuffle +1/+1 counters between your creatures, then get paid in cards and proliferate when they connect. Sunny, athletic, surprisingly technical.
commanders.plan: Concentrate counters on an evasive creature, draw and proliferate every combat.
commanders.youAre: Optimistic and team-oriented. You lift other people up, then ride the momentum.

commanders.name: Kinnan, Bonder Prodigy
commanders.tagline: Mana, but doubled, but also free monsters
commanders.blurb: Every nonland mana source produces extra, and the ability digs out huge non-human creatures. One of the strongest two-color engines in the format.
commanders.plan: Make absurd mana, dig out giant creatures, do it all a turn early.
commanders.youAre: An optimizer. You get a real kick out of an efficiency that borders on cheating.

commanders.name: Teysa Karlov
commanders.tagline: Death is just a business transaction
commanders.blurb: Your creatures are worth more dead than alive. Teysa doubles every death trigger, turning a small sacrifice into a funeral the whole table attends.
commanders.plan: Sacrifice tokens for doubled death triggers and drain everyone out of the game.
commanders.youAre: Organized, unsentimental and great at spreadsheets. Every loss is already priced in.

commanders.name: Zhulodok, Void Gorger
commanders.tagline: Colorless, gigantic, cascading into more gigantic things
commanders.blurb: Every huge colorless spell cascades twice, meaning one Eldrazi turns into three. No colors at all, which makes the mana base refreshingly simple.
commanders.plan: Ramp with artifacts, cast enormous Eldrazi, cascade into more enormous Eldrazi.
commanders.youAre: Drawn to scale and strangeness. Subtlety was never on the menu.

commanders.name: Atla Palani, Nest Tender
commanders.tagline: Hatch an egg, get a random monster
commanders.blurb: Make 0/1 eggs, break them, and reveal cards until a creature falls out onto the battlefield for free. Every egg is a lottery ticket you stacked.
commanders.plan: Make eggs, sacrifice them, cheat enormous creatures into play out of nowhere.
commanders.youAre: You like a surprise, as long as you built the surprise machine yourself.

commanders.name: Zurgo Stormrender
commanders.tagline: Disposable soldiers, permanent advantage
commanders.blurb: Mobilize makes free attackers that die at end of turn — and every token leaving the battlefield draws you a card or drains the table. Aggression with a safety net.
commanders.plan: Attack with temporary tokens, cash each one in for cards and damage.
commanders.youAre: Aggressive but not reckless. You like pressure that also pays rent.

commanders.name: Korvold, Fae-Cursed King
commanders.tagline: Greedy dragon, eats his own stuff, gets huge
commanders.blurb: Sacrifice treasure, tokens, lands, anything — Korvold draws a card and grows every time. The greed is the engine.
commanders.plan: Sacrifice everything you own for cards and counters, then attack with a giant dragon.
commanders.youAre: Maximalist. Why choose between card advantage and a huge monster?

commanders.name: Tom Bombadil
commanders.tagline: Sings a song, becomes invincible, chains sagas forever
commanders.blurb: Every saga that finishes finds the next one for free, and with enough lore counters he can't be touched. The weirdest, cosiest engine in the format.
commanders.plan: Chain sagas off each other, accumulate lore counters, become untouchable.
commanders.youAre: Unbothered by everyone else's drama. You're doing your own thing and it's working.

commanders.name: Gishath, Sun's Avatar
commanders.tagline: Hit someone. Dinosaurs fall out.
commanders.blurb: Gishath connects and you flip cards off the top, putting every dinosaur you hit directly onto the battlefield. The single most fun 'oh no' in the format.
commanders.plan: Ramp to Gishath, land one attack, vomit dinosaurs onto the table.
commanders.youAre: An unashamed theme player with big-swing energy. Spectacle over subtlety.

commanders.name: Arabella, Abandoned Doll
commanders.tagline: A tiny doll leading an army of tiny things
commanders.blurb: Attack and drain the table for the number of small creatures you control, gaining that much life. Cheap, fast, and quietly one of the best two-drops around.
commanders.plan: Flood the board with small creatures and drain everyone every combat.
commanders.youAre: You root for the little guys, and you've noticed that lots of little guys beat one big one.

commanders.name: Felothar the Steadfast
commanders.tagline: Attack with your defenses
commanders.blurb: Your creatures hit for their toughness and can attack even with defender, and you can trade one in for a fistful of cards. A fortress that swings back.
commanders.plan: Build huge-butted creatures, attack with the wall, sacrifice one for a refill.
commanders.youAre: Resilient. You like being the hardest person at the table to actually kill.

commanders.name: The Wandering Minstrel
commanders.tagline: Collect towns, sing a song, pump the band
commanders.blurb: A two-mana five-color commander that makes your lands enter untapped and rewards you for collecting Towns. Gentle, odd and surprisingly efficient.
commanders.plan: Assemble a strange land base, make elemental friends, finish with a big pump.
commanders.youAre: A wanderer and a completionist. You like maps with little icons to fill in.

commanders.name: Avatar Aang
commanders.tagline: Master all four elements, then break the mana cost rules
commanders.blurb: Bend water, earth, fire and air in one turn and he flips into a creature that makes your spells cost five less. A genuine puzzle, with a huge payoff.
commanders.plan: Trigger every bending type each turn, draw cards, transform and cast everything.
commanders.youAre: A generalist who refuses to specialize. You want to be good at all of it.

commanders.name: Shorikai, Genesis Engine
commanders.tagline: A giant mech that draws two cards a turn
commanders.blurb: Tap it for cards and pilot tokens, then crew it into an 8/8. It's a draw engine, a token engine and a finisher in one very large chassis.
commanders.plan: Loot every turn for free, build a pilot crew, swing with a giant vehicle.
commanders.youAre: An engineer at heart. You want the machine running smoothly before you do anything flashy.

commanders.name: Queen Marchesa
commanders.tagline: The crown, the knives, the smile
commanders.blurb: She makes you the monarch — everyone wants the crown, which means everyone is attacking someone else. You sit behind assassins and extra cards.
commanders.plan: Hold the monarchy, punish attackers, let the table fight over the throne.
commanders.youAre: The social player. You win games at the table as much as on the board.

commanders.name: Urza, Lord High Artificer
commanders.tagline: The mad inventor in the tower
commanders.blurb: Turns scrap into mana, mana into cards, cards into an unanswerable turn. The deck is a machine and you are the one who built it.
commanders.plan: Assemble artifacts until the board produces infinite resources, then cash them in.
commanders.youAre: The friend who redesigns the system instead of playing it. Elegance is the win condition.

commanders.name: Terra, Herald of Hope
commanders.tagline: Mill yourself, fly over, bring friends back
commanders.blurb: Every combat she self-mills and gains flying, and connecting reanimates a small creature. A cheap, elegant, grindy attacker.
commanders.plan: Attack in the air, fill your graveyard, reanimate a creature every turn.
commanders.youAre: Hopeful under pressure. You keep finding ways to rebuild after each setback.

commanders.name: Choco, Seeker of Paradise
commanders.tagline: A giant bird that finds you free lands
commanders.blurb: Birds attack, you dig for cards and drop lands straight onto the battlefield, and the landfall triggers keep rolling. Breezy and extremely consistent.
commanders.plan: Attack with birds, hit free land drops, snowball landfall value.
commanders.youAre: A road-trip person. The journey genuinely is the fun part for you.

commanders.name: Betor, Ancestor's Voice
commanders.tagline: Lifegain that turns into monsters and resurrections
commanders.blurb: Every point of life you gain in a turn becomes +1/+1 counters, and then brings a creature back from the dead. Three good decks wearing one trenchcoat.
commanders.plan: Gain big chunks of life, convert it to counters, reanimate along the way.
commanders.youAre: Generous and sturdy. You build things that look after themselves.

commanders.name: Go-Shintai of Life's Origin
commanders.tagline: A quiet shrine that never stops growing
commanders.blurb: Shrines trigger off each other every upkeep, and this one rebuilds the whole collection from the graveyard. Slow, serene, basically impossible to kill.
commanders.plan: Assemble shrines, trigger them all every upkeep, recur anything removed.
commanders.youAre: Contemplative and collection-minded. You like a set that completes itself.

commanders.name: Helga, Skittish Seer
commanders.tagline: A nervous frog that funds enormous creatures
commanders.blurb: Cast anything expensive and she draws, gains life and grows — then taps for a pile of mana to cast the next expensive thing. Ramp with a reward loop.
commanders.plan: Cast big creatures, grow Helga, use her to cast even bigger creatures.
commanders.youAre: Ambitious but careful. You save up and then spend it all at once.

commanders.name: Auntie Ool, Cursewretch
commanders.tagline: Minus-one-minus-one counters as a card-draw engine
commanders.blurb: Shrinking things kills opponents' creatures and draws you cards. A removal-heavy deck where every answer also refills your hand.
commanders.plan: Spread -1/-1 counters everywhere, draw off your own, drain off theirs.
commanders.youAre: Prickly, practical, and quietly in charge of everything.

commanders.name: K'rrik, Son of Yawgmoth
commanders.tagline: Pay in blood, not in mana
commanders.blurb: Every black mana can be paid with two life instead. Your life total is a currency and you intend to spend all of it.
commanders.plan: Burn life for absurdly fast spells, then drain the table before the bill comes due.
commanders.youAre: Ambitious and a touch reckless. You've never met a long-term consequence you couldn't out-run.

commanders.name: Zaxara, the Exemplary
commanders.tagline: Every X spell comes with a free hydra
commanders.blurb: Cast anything with an X in the cost and get a hydra of that size for free. Doubles as a mana engine. Big numbers, free monsters, happy times.
commanders.plan: Ramp hard, cast enormous X spells, collect a free hydra with each one.
commanders.youAre: You like the slider all the way to the right. How big can it get? Let's find out.

commanders.name: Kotis, the Fangkeeper
commanders.tagline: Hit them, then play their deck
commanders.blurb: Combat damage exiles cards off their library and lets you cast them for free. Indestructible, evasive, and funded entirely by other people.
commanders.plan: Make Kotis huge and unblockable, then cast whatever falls out of their deck.
commanders.youAre: An opportunist with good taste. Why build it when you can take it?

commanders.name: Terra, Magical Adept
commanders.tagline: Mill into enchantments, then become one
commanders.blurb: She digs into your graveyard for enchantments, then flips into an Esper saga that rewrites the board. A build-up deck with a dramatic second act.
commanders.plan: Set up enchantments and graveyard value, then transform for a huge payoff.
commanders.youAre: A late bloomer who likes a transformation arc. Patience, then fireworks.

commanders.name: The First Sliver
commanders.tagline: A hive mind that casts itself for free
commanders.blurb: Every sliver cascades into another sliver. One cast becomes four, the whole team shares abilities, and the board becomes a single enormous organism.
commanders.plan: Cast slivers, cascade into more slivers, overwhelm with a shared-ability horde.
commanders.youAre: You love a collective. The hive is greater than the individual and you're fine with that.

commanders.name: Kilo, Apogee Mind
commanders.tagline: A robot that proliferates every time it taps
commanders.blurb: Tap it for anything — crewing, abilities, attacking — and every counter on the board grows. A clean, elegant engine for anyone who loves a counter.
commanders.plan: Tap Kilo as many times a turn as possible, proliferating everything each time.
commanders.youAre: A systems thinker. You enjoy finding how many times one trigger can be re-used.

commanders.name: Sisay, Weatherlight Captain
commanders.tagline: Tutor up any legend, any time
commanders.blurb: She grows with every color you control and fetches legendary permanents straight onto the battlefield. A toolbox that always has the answer.
commanders.plan: Grow Sisay with legendary permanents, then tutor the exact piece you need.
commanders.youAre: A planner who hates drawing the wrong card. You want the toolbox, not the gamble.

commanders.name: Xyris, the Writhing Storm
commanders.tagline: Everyone draws a thousand cards. You get snakes.
commanders.blurb: Wheel the table over and over; every extra card an opponent draws makes you a snake. Generosity and punishment in equal measure.
commanders.plan: Force mass draws, build a snake army, swing for an absurd refill.
commanders.youAre: The chaos-friendly host. Everyone has a great time, you win, nobody's quite sure how.

commanders.name: Ghyrson Starn, Kelermorph
commanders.tagline: Every tiny ping becomes a real hit
commanders.blurb: Any source of yours dealing exactly 1 damage instead deals 2 more. Suddenly every incidental ping in your deck is a removal spell.
commanders.plan: Build a deck of 1-damage pingers and turn them all into artillery.
commanders.youAre: A detail person. You found the interaction nobody noticed and built around it.

commanders.name: Ragost, Deft Gastronaut
commanders.tagline: A lobster chef turning your artifacts into dinner
commanders.blurb: All your artifacts become Food, you eat them for life, and eating untaps Ragost to throw three damage at everyone. Cheap, fast, and very silly.
commanders.plan: Make artifacts, sacrifice them as Food, machine-gun the table for 3 at a time.
commanders.youAre: A home cook with a chaotic streak. Everything is an ingredient if you're brave.

commanders.name: Norman Osborn
commanders.tagline: Unblockable businessman, eventual flying menace
commanders.blurb: He can't be blocked, connives on damage, and transforms into the Green Goblin when you decide the mask comes off. A great villain arc in one card.
commanders.plan: Connive every turn to sculpt a perfect hand, then flip and go on the offensive.
commanders.youAre: Two-sided. Polished in public, absolutely feral about your hobbies.

commanders.name: Eriette of the Charmed Apple
commanders.tagline: Enchant their creatures so they can't attack you
commanders.blurb: Auras on their creatures turn off attacks against you, and every aura drains the table at end of turn. A fairy-tale pillow fort that quietly kills everyone.
commanders.plan: Put auras on everything, lock down attackers, drain the table each end step.
commanders.youAre: Charming and a tiny bit manipulative. You prefer not to be attacked, thank you.

commanders.name: Hope Estheim
commanders.tagline: Gain life, mill them out
commanders.blurb: Every point of life you gain in a turn mills each opponent. A two-mana commander that wins by decking the table while quietly building a huge life total.
commanders.plan: Chain lifegain triggers and convert them into mass mill.
commanders.youAre: Kind but goal-focused. You'd never attack anyone. You'd just end the game.

commanders.name: Henzie "Toolbox" Torre
commanders.tagline: Big creatures, cheap, hasty, and briefly
commanders.blurb: Blitz lets you cast huge creatures early with haste — they die at end of turn, but you draw a card. A deck full of enormous one-night stands.
commanders.plan: Blitz oversized creatures every turn, attack immediately, draw when they die.
commanders.youAre: Impatient and generous. You'd rather do the exciting thing now than hold it back.

commanders.name: Captain N'ghathrod
commanders.tagline: Mill them, then steal what you milled
commanders.blurb: Horrors with menace mill opponents on damage, and at end of turn you reanimate the best thing that hit their graveyard. Piracy with tentacles.
commanders.plan: Attack with menacing horrors, mill the table, steal their best creatures.
commanders.youAre: A connoisseur of other people's good ideas. You'll take care of it better anyway.

commanders.name: Urtet, Remnant of Memnarch
commanders.tagline: Myr. Hundreds of them. All untapping.
commanders.blurb: Every Myr spell makes a Myr token, they all untap each combat, and for five colors of mana they all get huge. Robot tribal with a real combo ceiling.
commanders.plan: Build a Myr army, untap them for mana every turn, pump and swing.
commanders.youAre: Fascinated by repetition and scale. A hundred small identical things is your aesthetic.

commanders.name: Omnath, Locus of Creation
commanders.tagline: Lands, but as a win condition
commanders.blurb: Every land you play gives life, then mana, then damage. Turn one it's a nature documentary; turn seven it's a weather event.
commanders.plan: Play extra lands every turn and convert landfall into an avalanche of value.
commanders.youAre: Growth-oriented and generous with your own time. You like a build that rewards patience.

commanders.name: Voja, Jaws of the Conclave
commanders.tagline: Wolves and elves, counters everywhere
commanders.blurb: Attack and every creature you control gets counters equal to your elf count, plus a card for each wolf. Two tribes, one enormous attack step.
commanders.plan: Build an elf board, attack with Voja, dump counters on everything and draw.
commanders.youAre: A team captain. You want the whole squad to level up together.

commanders.name: High Perfect Morcant
commanders.tagline: Elves that shrink everyone else's board
commanders.blurb: Every elf that arrives puts a -1/-1 counter on an opponent's creature, and you can tap three elves to proliferate it all. Tribal removal on a stick.
commanders.plan: Build an elf board, blight the table's creatures, proliferate until they're gone.
commanders.youAre: Disciplined and a touch merciless. You like winning by making others smaller.

commanders.name: Witherbloom, the Balancer
commanders.tagline: An eight-drop dragon you cast for three
commanders.blurb: Affinity for creatures makes this huge flier cheap — and then your instants and sorceries get the discount too. A deathtouch dragon that enables a whole deck.
commanders.plan: Build a creature board, cast the dragon early, then cast spells nearly free.
commanders.youAre: Efficient to a fault. You hate paying full price for anything.

commanders.name: Alela, Cunning Conqueror
commanders.tagline: Play on their turn, make faeries, start fights
commanders.blurb: Hold up instants; every turn cycle you get a flying faerie, and when faeries connect you goad a creature so someone else gets attacked. Perfect control-politics.
commanders.plan: Play at instant speed, accrue faeries, goad the table into fighting each other.
commanders.youAre: Reactive and sly. You'd rather respond than commit, and you love redirecting trouble.

commanders.name: Magda, Brazen Outlaw
commanders.tagline: Dwarves make treasure; treasure finds dragons
commanders.blurb: Tap dwarves for treasure, then trade five treasures for any artifact or dragon in your deck. A two-mana tutor engine that looks completely harmless.
commanders.plan: Build a dwarf crew, generate treasure, tutor out game-ending artifacts.
commanders.youAre: A scrappy schemer. Small resources, converted cleverly, into something enormous.

commanders.name: Obeka, Splitter of Seconds
commanders.tagline: Extra upkeeps: the most broken boring phrase in Magic
commanders.blurb: Connect and you get that many extra upkeep steps — meaning every 'at the beginning of your upkeep' card fires again and again. Deckbuilding as a dare.
commanders.plan: Make Obeka connect, then trigger a hand full of upkeep effects many times over.
commanders.youAre: A rules-text sicko in the best way. You read the fine print for fun.

commanders.name: Marneus Calgar
commanders.tagline: Space marines: make tokens, draw cards, double strike
commanders.blurb: Any tokens entering draws you a card, and he can make his own at will. A disciplined, armored value engine with a real clock attached.
commanders.plan: Produce tokens constantly, draw a card every time, win with double strike.
commanders.youAre: Dependable and organized. You bring a plan, a backup, and extra sleeves.
